propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue submits status as a field edit via issue.update(fields=...) instead of routing it through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status change silently since status is not an editable field
Cloud transport (adapters/jira/acli.py) correctly routes status to transition_issue_by_name, but the Data Center transport lacks this routing, creating an asymmetry between backends

Outbound status changes never reach the DC issue because the dispatcher sends status through _update_one_filter_fields to update_issue without calling transition_issue_by_name, unlike the inbound setup path which calls it directly
Illegal transitions from the current workflow state must be handled non-fatally as bridge alerts rather than silently failing or aborting the batch
A single update_issue call must support both status routing to a transition and field edits for other allowlisted fields like assignee in the same request
